scenes.audio: A sharp, high-pitched digital 'ding' sound effect accompanied by a subtle electronic swoosh.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static, centered wide shot of a clean, minimalist white digital card interface. The card features a header in a gray sans-serif font. At the bottom, a dark gray horizontal bar contains a bold white label and a currency counter displaying '$0.00'. The lighting is perfectly even across the frame, simulating a bright studio white background. The color palette is strictly monochromatic (white, light gray, dark gray).

scenes.audio: Two rapid, percussive 'click' sounds mimicking a mechanical keyboard, followed by a soft synth pulse.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The camera remains static. Two lines of text and numerical data appear instantly in the white section of the card. The top line shows a specific currency value of $2.40, and the second line shows $0.60. The dark gray bar at the bottom updates its total to '$2.39' with a rapid digital rolling number animation. The lighting and color grading remain consistent with the previous scene.

scenes.audio: A single, resonant 'pop' sound effect as the third line appears, followed by a short upward-gliding melodic chime.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A third line of data appears in the center of the white card, showing a value of $1.80. The bottom dark gray bar immediately updates to show a new total of '$3.00'. The movement is purely digital text rendering. The environment is a sterile, flat white digital space with no shadows or depth.

scenes.audio: A bright, triumphant high-pitched bell chime signifies the final calculation, fading out into a low-frequency hum.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The final state of the digital interface. The central white section remains populated with the three previous lines of data. The bottom dark gray bar performs a final calculation animation, settling on the figure '$4.80'. A small yellow and purple logo is visible in the top right corner of the frame throughout the entire duration. The shot is static until the end of the clip.
